description: Return the Isogen-style SKEY vocabulary Piping Toolset uses (component prefixes, end-condition suffixes, fitting and support keys) with scope 'isogen', or the PCF record set, substitutions and default SKEYs that import cleanly into CAESAR II with scope 'caesar-safe'. `component` narrows the result to one group, e.g. 'valve_prefix' or 'safe_substitutions'.

component.description: Optional group name within the scope

scope.description: isogen = SKEY registry; caesar-safe = PCF records for CAESAR II import

name: get_skey_map
title: SKEY and PCF mapping
